Perfect! Now I have all the information I need. Let me compile the audit results into a clear table format:

## Rankora Roadmap Audit (Sections 7-12)

Based on my thorough examination of the codebase at `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Rankora`, here's the status of each roadmap feature:

| Feature | Status | Key File(s) |
|---------|--------|-----------|
| **Section 7: Apply via LinkedIn** | BUILT ✓ | `/src/pages/Apply.tsx` |
| **Section 8: ZIP Upload** | MISSING ✗ | `/src/components/BulkUploadZone.tsx` |
| **Section 9: Assign & Track** | PARTIAL | `/src/hooks/useTeamDashboard.tsx` |
| **Section 10: Candidate Tags** | MISSING ✗ | N/A |
| **Section 11: Bulk Actions** | BUILT ✓ | `/src/components/JobDetailView.tsx` |
| **Section 12: Candidate Notes** | BUILT ✓ | `/src/components/candidate/CandidateNotesPanel.tsx` |
| **Tier 2: WhatsApp Outreach** | BUILT ✓ | `/src/components/candidate/WhatsAppOutreachDialog.tsx` |
| **Tier 2: AI Rejection Feedback** | BUILT ✓ | `/src/components/candidate/RejectCandidateDialog.tsx` |
| **Tier 2: API Docs & Keys** | BUILT ✓ | `/src/components/settings/ApiKeysCard.tsx` |

---

### Detailed Findings:

**SECTION 7 - Apply Page** ✓ COMPLETE
- Name field: YES
- Email field: YES  
- Phone field: YES
- Resume upload: YES (PDF, DOCX, DOC, RTF, TXT; max 10MB)
- LinkedIn URL field: YES (with validation)
- Custom form fields: YES (supports text, number, select, multiselect, date, url, textarea, checkbox)

**SECTION 8 - ZIP Upload** ✗ MISSING
- `BulkUploadZone.tsx` supports only individual resume uploads (PDF, DOCX, DOC, RTF, TXT)
- No ZIP file support or JSZip library detected
- No ZIP extraction/bulk unpack functionality

**SECTION 9 - Assign & Track** ⚠ PARTIAL
- `assigned_to` field exists in Tasks system (`src/hooks/useTeamDashboard.tsx`, `src/hooks/useTasks.tsx`)
- **BUT**: This applies to Tasks (team tasks), NOT candidate assignment
- No `assigned_to` field on candidates or resumes
- Candidates can only be viewed in shared team dashboards; no "assign to team member" feature for individual candidates

**SECTION 10 - Candidate Tags** ✗ MISSING  
- No tags field on candidates or resumes
- No tagging system found in codebase
- Candidate grouping uses only stages (applied, shortlist, interview, offer, rejected)

**SECTION 11 - Bulk Actions** ✓ BUILT
- `selectedResumes` set state at line 285 of `JobDetailView.tsx`
- Checkbox selection for all candidates visible
- "Select all" checkbox in table header (line 1848)
- Bulk delete action (line 1836)
- Individual archive/unarchive available (`handleArchive`, `handleUnarchive`)
- Note: Archive/unarchive are individual actions, not bulk batch actions

**SECTION 12 - Candidate Notes** ✓ BUILT
- Note types: General, Positive, Concern, Flag ✓
- Color-coded labels: Muted, Emerald, Amber, Red ✓
- @mention support with team member filtering ✓
- Notes visible to entire team (on job) ✓
- Delete notes functionality ✓
- No "resolved" state visible in code

**TIER 2: WhatsApp** ✓ BUILT
- `WhatsAppOutreachDialog.tsx` exists and is integrated
- Uses `wa.me/` URL format with encoded messages
- Phone number formatting for WhatsApp compatibility
- Button appears in candidate detail sheet

**TIER 2: AI Rejection Feedback** ✓ BUILT
- `RejectCandidateDialog.tsx` generates personalized rejection emails
- Feedback uses candidate's strengths and gaps from resume analysis
- Auto-generates subject and body with AI-powered context
- Sends email + moves candidate to "rejected" stage

**TIER 2: API Keys & Docs** ✓ BUILT
- `ApiKeysCard.tsx` with full key management
- Key generation (rk_live_* format)
- Key creation, deletion, reveal/hide
- localStorage-based persistence
- Webhook management with event types (job.created, ranking.completed, candidate.applied, candidate.rejected, interview.scheduled)

---

### Summary:
- **Fully Built: 6 features** (Apply, Bulk Actions, Notes, WhatsApp, AI Rejection, API Keys)
- **Partially Built: 1 feature** (Assign—exists for tasks, not candidates)
- **Missing: 2 features** (ZIP Upload, Candidate Tags)
